digest.component_or_area: Code review framework / CI gate verification
propositions: New hard-fail CI gates are being added without grandfather guards, breaking branches created before the gate was introduced (e.g. medium-loved-newt, impudent-sodium-ferret, rancid-aerophobic-skylark, brattish-ladyish-jaguar).
Project code-review criteria are dispatched unconditionally with no glob-based filtering, making applies_to ineffective for project criteria.

A new advisory code-review criterion project.ci-gate-compat must detect pipeline/gate-configuration changes that introduce hard-fail steps with no if-present/grandfather guard, triggerable via CI-agnostic declarative globs without hard-coding vendor names.
The applies_to glob set must be project-overridable via [code_review] ci_config_globs config key so unusual pipelines are declared rather than enumerated in shipped code.
Gate dispatch and criteria routing must be refactored to filter activated project criteria against their applies_to globs against the review's changed files.
